Tip of the week: train both directions. 🔄

Golf turns you the same way thousands of times a season. If your rotation drills only go one way too, you're doubling down on the same pattern.
✅ Do every rotation drill to both sides
✅ Spend a few extra reps on the side that feels stiffer or weaker
❌ Don't skip your "bad" side because it feels awkward

Save this and share it with your playing partner.
